text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Tuesday as reported by the official Algerian news agency APS. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Liamine Zeroual starts an Asian tour which takes him to Bahrain, China, Vietnam and Qatar.
- Zeroual sets November 28 as date for the referendum to amend the constitution.

- Widespread use of Arabic language in unversity, administration and business spheres by 1998 seen as preposterous goal. The Transitional National Council debates a draft Arabic language law before vote.
- World Bank experts, attending conference on privatisation in Algiers, proposed the sale of Algerian state-owned companies before being restructured.
- Zeroual, calling for vote to change the constitution on November 28, says loopholes in the current constitution had allowed politicians' attempts to undermine Algeria's unity.
